findings.title: RuntimeException bypasses MojoExecutionException error handling
findings.body: In verifySafeHtml(), IOException while reading either the current file or the English file is wrapped in a RuntimeException and thrown. This occurs inside the try block of verify(), which only catches IOException. As a result, any I/O error (missing English file, permission issue, etc.) will propagate as an uncaught RuntimeException instead of the expected MojoExecutionException, causing the Maven plugin to fail with a stack trace that does not conform to standard error handling and may hide the underlying cause.

findings.title: Italian text in Lithuanian translation
findings.body: The value for totpStep1 was replaced with the Italian phrase "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:". This is clearly a copy-paste error and produces an incorrect Lithuanian translation. Users with Lithuanian locale will see Italian instructions. The original Lithuanian text should be restored or properly translated.

findings.title: Italian text in Lithuanian translation
findings.body: The value for loginTotpStep1 was replaced with the Italian phrase "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:". This is the same copy-paste error as in the account messages file, causing Italian text to appear for Lithuanian users on the login page TOTP setup step.

findings.title: Traditional Chinese text in simplified Chinese translation
findings.body: The value for totpStep1 was changed from simplified Chinese to traditional Chinese ("在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一："). The file is intended for the zh_CN (simplified) locale, so this introduces an incorrect variant. The simplified Chinese text should be used instead.
